description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

 About the Role: 
 Like to ship meaningful products and generally get things done? As an Infrastructure Engineer on CrowdStrike's TechOps CICD Image Management team, you will be a key contributor to a team of engineers responsible for building, maintaining, and delivering the golden images that power CrowdStrike's software factory at scale. Linux is at the core of our image fleet, with macOS and Windows rounding out a multi-platform pipeline that thousands of daily builds and tests depend on. A core part of this role is contributing to Ceramic, our internal golden-image build platform that automates the full image lifecycle: from upstream OS through hardening, compliance testing, SBOM tracking, and approval workflows before images reach production consumers. You will own both the images themselves and the platform that produces them, with a heavy emphasis on Python-driven automation and Infrastructure as Code practices.

 What You’ll Do: 

 Maintain and extend Ceramic, our internal image build platform, including new feature development, bug fixes, and integrations with upstream tooling
 Design, build, and maintain automated golden image pipelines with a primary focus on Linux, extending to macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon) and Windows
 Compile and package software from source to satisfy internal framework and compatibility requirements
 Write Python tooling and automation to manage image builds, validation, drift detection, and regression testing
 Author and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Ansible, Packer, and Terraform for image configuration, provisioning, and compliance hardening
 Integrate image build pipelines with Jenkins and GitLab CI, and publish artifacts via Artifactory
 Manage image lifecycle across the CI/CD fleet including provisioning, deployment, and decommission
 Collaborate with security and compliance teams to ensure images meet CrowdStrike's security standards and pass automated scanning
 Respond to and resolve image-related production issues across the CI/CD fleet
 Partner with product engineering teams to evaluate and onboard new toolchain requirements
 Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer within the team
 
 What You'll Need: 

 US Citizen or Green Card holder
 Strong Linux systems engineering experience at scale, including low-level knowledge of the build toolchain, package management, shared libraries, and compiling software from source
 Python proficiency, you write automation, tooling, and scripts in Python as a first choice
 Software development experience, you are comfortable owning and extending an internal platform or service
 Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools including Ansible (playbooks, roles, AWX/Tower), Packer, and Terraform
 Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and/or GitLab CI
 Experience with artifact management tools, Artifactory preferred
 Understanding of virtualization concepts, experience with VMware, KVM, or similar hypervisors
 Familiarity with macOS and Windows system administration in a CI/CD or build environment
 Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across OS, network, and application layers
 Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. 
 
 Bonus Points: 

 Familiarity with macOS MDM, DEP, or Apple Business Manager
 Kubernetes experience, on-prem preferred
 Background in security hardening (CIS benchmarks, STIG, Falcon sensor management)
 Prior work in a large-scale CI/CD or build infrastructure environment
 
 Key Qualifications: 

 4+ years of experience in a software or infrastructure engineering environment
 Must be able to participate in an on-call rotation
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 Ability to work effectively across a distributed team in multiple time zones
 Meticulous attention to detail and sound judgment in a fast-moving environment
 Security mindset with a general understanding of cybersecurity principles
